original_text: Consider the following recursive function: recfn(N) if N <= 0 then return 0 else if N mod 2 = 0 then return recfn(N-1) - N else return recfn(N-1) + N endif endif end recfn Determine the value of variable X after execution of the following program statement: X = recfn(5) Show all your working.

12. (a)   Consider the following recursive function:
recfn(N)
    if N <= 0
        then
            return 0
        else
            if N mod 2 = 0
                then
                    return recfn(N-1) - N
                else
                    return recfn(N-1) + N
            endif
    endif
end recfn
Determine the value of variable X after execution of the following program statement:
X = recfn(5)
